subject: MAP compliance standup: evidence bundle, pen-test window & next steps
messages:
From: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evidence ask & pen test window request

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood last week. We’re ready to progress the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and prioritize the security/compliance bucket so our legal and infosec teams can sign off. Two immediate asks from our side:

1) Evidence bundle: we need a short SOC 2 bridge summary, DPA confirmation, and a pointer to audit logs (retention and example exports). Can you confirm what you can provide this week?

2) Pen test: our vendor is asking for a target window. Ideally we’d run a focused penetration test against the inference endpoints and staging environment sometime Jul 20–24. Can Redwood support that window or suggest alternatives?

High-level timeline: we’re aiming to close contract & infra acceptance by end of July. Please share a quick MAP status update and owners so I can update our procurement team.

Appreciate it — Emily
Emily Jensen
VP Product, ClearWave Health
emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com

---
Attachments: none
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evidence ask & pen test window request

Emily — thanks, and great to see momentum. Short update below and propose a quick 30-min sync to align owners.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2 / DPA: we can provide a SOC 2 bridge summary (PDF) and our standard DPA today; full auditor artifacts will take a short lead if requested by your auditor.
- Audit logs: we can export API request logs and KV/cache access logs; retention is 90 days by default for hosted deployments, configurable on Dedicated.
- Pen test window: tentative yes for Jul 20–24 but need to confirm staging creds and scope with our security vendor — copying Karthik.

Attached: MAP-action-tracker.xlsx (starter tracker), initial-pen-scope.docx (draft scope).

Proposed owners (prelim):
- Evidence gather & export: Monica Patel (Customer Success) — owner for pulling bundles and Drive share.
- Security QA & pen scope: Karthik Iyer (Security) — owner for scope and vendor coordination.
- Legal / commercial: Sean Gallagher (Sales) — owner for contract timeline and PO/NDAs.

If you confirm the Jul 20–24 preference, I’ll loop our pen test partner and lock timelines. Can we do 30 minutes Tue morning to walk through the evidence list?

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: MAP-action-tracker.xlsx, initial-pen-scope.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evidence ask & pen test window request

Sean / Monica — quick security note after initial triage: 

Evidence availability and ETA:
- SOC 2 bridge report: PDF export available; full auditor binders ~10 business days if they request raw evidence.
- Audit logs: we can produce API-level request/export CSVs and S3 access logs. ETA for curated export: 3 business days (Mon -> Thu).
- DPA: standard DPA (signed template) is available immediately.

Pen test scope suggestions (recommended narrow scope):
- Focus: public inference endpoints, authentication flows, and staging S3 buckets used for model artifacts.
- Exclude: internal infra orchestration plane and production customer data (we will provide sanitized test data).
- Requirements from vendor: staging creds, IP allowlist, one-week prep window for smoke tests.

I’ll produce a pen-scope-v2.docx with the specifics and list of required staging accounts. Also will need to confirm whether ClearWave wants live traffic replay (throughput tests) — if yes, infra team needs to schedule a small maintenance window.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pen-scope-v2.docx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: proposed action items & shared evidence folder

Emily — putting this in writing following Sean/Karthik’s notes and to capture owners for procurement. I’ll also create the Drive folder and share ACLs with your security and procurement aliases.

Meeting notes (prep for 30-min sync):
- Goal: get ClearWave the SOC2 summary, DPA, and example audit logs; finalize pen-test scope and vendor terms; agree on a final acceptance checklist for infra.

Action items (proposed):
1) SOC2 bridge summary (deliverable): Monica — due 2026-07-09 (short PDF)
2) Curated audit logs export (deliverable): Monica — due 2026-07-09 (CSV + README)
3) Final pen test scope (deliverable): Karthik — due 2026-07-08 (pen-scope-v2.docx)
4) Vendor SOW & scheduling: Sean — coordinate with vendor, secure PO/NDA — due 2026-07-12
5) Staging credentials & allowlist: Redwood infra (owner: Marissa Cole) — due 2026-07-16

I’ve created: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-clearwave-MAP and shared with emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com and security@clearwavehealth.com. I’ll upload the SOC2 bridge summary and the starter audit exports there once complete.

Blocker: our SOC2 auditor has a short blackout next week which may shift the final binder availability by a few days; I’ll flag if that changes the acceptance timeline.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
From: Rahul Singh <rahul@pentestpro.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP: evidence ask & pen test window request

Sean / Emily — Rahul from PentestPro here. We can support a focused test. A few items we need to proceed: 

- Signed SOW / PO (please see attached Pentest-Statement-of-Work.pdf).
- Staging credentials (scoped test account) and IP allowlist for our test agents.
- NDA or extant mutual NDA (if you prefer).

Availability: our team can be on-site/remote the week of Jul 27–31 (we have limited bandwidth Jul 20–24). If ClearWave prefers earlier, we can spin up a small team but will need 5 business days notice.

We’ll also need confirmation whether the test will include a limited social engineering/supply-chain assessment — default is code & infra only.

Thanks,
Rahul Singh
PentestPro, Senior Consultant
rahul@pentestpro.io

Attachments: Pentest-Statement-of-Work.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jensen <emily.jensen@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, rahul@pentestpro.io
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint update: revised pen-test window & action-item status

Emily — quick checkpoint and consolidation of action items after vendor feedback and our internal auditor note. TL;DR: we are aligned but a small schedule shift is required.

Summary update (items with current status):
- SOC2 bridge summary: Monica working on PDF, expected upload by 2026-07-13 (was 07-09; delayed due to auditor blackout).
- Curated audit logs export: Monica expected 2026-07-14 (still on track to provide CSV + README).
- Final pen scope: Karthik uploaded pen-scope-v2.docx on 2026-07-06 to the shared Drive.
- Vendor SOW: Rahul sent SOW; Sean to coordinate PO/NDA.
- Staging creds & allowlist: Marissa to provision staging accounts; target ready by 2026-07-22.

Pen-test window: Rahul indicates limited bandwidth Jul 20–24; recommended window Jul 27–31 to ensure full coverage. Redwood proposes Jul 27–31 for the test. Please confirm if ClearWave can accept Jul 27–31. If you need earlier, we can escalate but it will require a 5-business-day prep and potential extra vendor cost.

Action items (current owners & new dates):
- Monica Patel: upload SOC2 bridge summary (2026-07-13) and audit logs export (2026-07-14).
- Karthik Iyer: finalize scope sign-off with vendor (ongoing).
- Marissa Cole: provision staging creds & IP allowlist (2026-07-22).
- Sean Gallagher: coordinate SOW/PO and sign-off (2026-07-15).

Blockers / Notes:
- Auditor blackout caused a small delay for the SOC2 binder; will escalate if it affects contract acceptance.
- If ClearWave confirms Jul 27–31, Rahul can proceed with scheduling and we’ll finalize credentials and SOW in the coming week.

Next step: Emily, can you please confirm acceptance of Jul 27–31 for the pen test and whether procurement needs any additional documents from our side (PO template, W-9, vendor security questionnaire)?

Thanks — I’ll update the Drive and the HubSpot deal RW-5482 after we get confirmation.

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
